column1: # catalog-projects.tsv -- per-project build and dependency directories.
# Distinct from catalog-dev.tsv, which lists GLOBAL tool caches at fixed paths.
# These are names that appear inside individual projects, wherever those live.
#             compares name rules with `base == pat`, so globs cannot be used.
#             `deps` costs a reinstall to restore, so it is PROTECTED while a
#             project is active. `build`/`cache` regenerate from source alone
#             and are offered even in an active project, never preselected.
#   tier      T1 lockfile-backed | T2 manifest-only | T3 pure derived.
#             Nominal: a T1 row whose lockfile is absent is recomputed as T2.
#   ambig     1 = the name is also used for source directories, so this is
#             never preselected at any age. See docs/PROJECTS.md.
#   manifest  comma-separated patterns expected at the project root; - if none
#   lockfile  comma-separated lockfile names; - if none
#   inmarker  path RELATIVE TO THE ARTIFACT proving it is that tool's output
#   restore   the exact command that regenerates it. Goes verbatim into evidence.
#   why       prose lead-in for the evidence sentence
# Two names are deliberately absent from the guard's rule table and can only
#   Library  -- ALLOWNAME Library resolves $HOME/Library to ALLOW, because no
#              DENY prefix covers it and a length-0 name rule beats deny_len -1.
#              Verified. Unity's import cache cannot be expressed safely.
